name: VelocityButton
description: Interactive button with a directional energy trail and perimeter glow that responds to pointer velocity without expensive particle emitters.
a11yNotes: Updates CSS custom properties directly on the DOM node for zero React re-renders during pointer movement and disables the directional trail when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

propsApi.name: trailColor
propsApi.description: Color of the velocity-reactive energy trail.

propsApi.name: trailIntensity
propsApi.description: Maximum opacity multiplier of the energy trail.
